name: Maestro
description: MIDI auto-player for the band instrument — playlists, group sync and a local sound preview.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Performing a song in-world with the Library, Auto-Player and Preview windows open.
Auto-Player — playlist, queue and playback controls.
Library — browse your MIDI folder and add songs to the queue.
Local Preview — audition through the real in-game instrument sounds.
Settings — per-song controls, Network Sync and Ensemble options.

added: The plugin's text now displays in your chosen language — English, 日本語 (Japanese), ไทย (Thai), Bahasa Indonesia, and Filipino. Set it in Stellar's Settings → Themes → Language (or leave it on "Follow game client").
